about: Ranking rules for the review-queue pages (queue/build.py). A pull request's tier is the lowest tier number any of its changed files falls in; within a tier the needs-a-review track orders by age at the current head (oldest first) and then by size (smallest first). Change a rule by pull request; the page shows, per row, the rule lines that placed it.

tracks.needs_review: open, not a draft, title not marked WIP, head pushed within stale_days, no review by anyone but the author at the current head, and no peeryard review at that head; ordered by tier, then by days at the current head (longest waiting first), then by size
tracks.needs_maintainer: open, not a draft, at least one review at the current head, CI green or absent, mergeable state clean; ordered by days since the last activity
tracks.carried: open upstream pull requests this tree carries as patches (patches/*/patches.json with an upstream_pr and a status that is not candidate, withdrawn or merged-in-<tag>), ordered by how many examples need them
tracks.stale: open pull requests whose head is older than stale_days: listed at the end, unranked, so the work list stays a work list

not_a_factor: the author (every pull request is scored the same way, peeryard's own included)
